import argparse
import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import re

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('--input', type=str, required=True)
parser.add_argument('--output', type=str, required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()

input_fp = os.path.join(args.input, 'previous_data.csv')
output_dir = args.output
os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)

df = pd.read_csv(input_fp)

# Parse and validate Blood Pressure format before using it
bp_series = df['Blood Pressure'].astype(str)

# ASSERTION_START
pattern_ok = bp_series.str.match(r'^\d{2,3}/\d{2,3}$').fillna(False)
assert pattern_ok.all()
# ASSERTION_END

bp_parts = bp_series.str.extract(r'(?P<systolic>\d{2,3})/(?P<diastolic>\d{2,3})')

systolic = bp_parts['systolic'].astype(int)
diastolic = bp_parts['diastolic'].astype(int)

# ASSERTION_START
rng_ok = systolic.between(90, 200) & diastolic.between(50, 130) & (systolic > diastolic)
assert rng_ok.all()
# ASSERTION_END

# Age checks before age-based logic
age_num = pd.to_numeric(df['Age'], errors='raise')

# ASSERTION_START
age_ok = age_num.notna() & age_num.between(18, 80) & ((age_num % 1) == 0)
assert age_ok.all()
# ASSERTION_END

age = age_num.astype(int)

# Sleep Duration checks before banding and scoring
sleep_duration = pd.to_numeric(df['Sleep Duration'], errors='raise')

# ASSERTION_START
sd_ok = sleep_duration.notna() & sleep_duration.between(3.0, 12.0)
assert sd_ok.all()
# ASSERTION_END

# ASSERTION_START
in_core = sleep_duration.between(5.0, 9.0)
prop_core = in_core.mean()
assert prop_core >= 0.80
# ASSERTION_END

# Quality of Sleep checks before mapping
qos_num = pd.to_numeric(df['Quality of Sleep'], errors='raise')

# ASSERTION_START
qos_bounds = qos_num.notna() & qos_num.between(1, 10) & ((qos_num % 1) == 0)
assert qos_bounds.all()
# ASSERTION_END

# ASSERTION_START
qos_window_ok = qos_num.between(4, 9)
assert qos_window_ok.all()
# ASSERTION_END

# ASSERTION_START
prop_high_q = qos_num.isin([6, 7, 8, 9]).mean()
assert prop_high_q >= 0.90
# ASSERTION_END

# Stress Level checks before mapping
stress_num = pd.to_numeric(df['Stress Level'], errors='raise')

# ASSERTION_START
stress_ok = stress_num.notna() & stress_num.between(1, 10) & ((stress_num % 1) == 0)
assert stress_ok.all()
# ASSERTION_END

# ASSERTION_START
stress_obs_ok = stress_num.between(3, 8)
assert stress_obs_ok.all()
# ASSERTION_END

# Cross-constraints Sleep Duration <-> Quality of Sleep
# ASSERTION_START
c1 = (~sleep_duration.lt(5.0)) | qos_num.le(6)
c2 = (~sleep_duration.ge(8.0)) | qos_num.ge(7)
assert c1.all() and c2.all()
# ASSERTION_END

# Physical Activity Level checks before banding
pal_num = pd.to_numeric(df['Physical Activity Level'], errors='raise')

# ASSERTION_START
pal_ok = pal_num.notna() & pal_num.between(0, 180) & ((pal_num % 1) == 0)
assert pal_ok.all()
# ASSERTION_END

# Daily Steps checks before banding
steps_num = pd.to_numeric(df['Daily Steps'], errors='raise')

# ASSERTION_START
steps_ok = steps_num.notna() & steps_num.between(0, 40000) & ((steps_num % 1) == 0)
assert steps_ok.all()
# ASSERTION_END

# Cross-constraints PAL <-> Steps used for engagement rules
# ASSERTION_START
c_pal_hi = (~pal_num.ge(90)) | steps_num.ge(9000)
c_pal_lo = (~pal_num.le(30)) | steps_num.le(6000)
assert c_pal_hi.all() and c_pal_lo.all()
# ASSERTION_END

# BMI Category checks before mapping
bmi = df['BMI Category'].astype(str)
allowed_bmi = {'Normal', 'Normal Weight', 'Overweight', 'Obese'}

# ASSERTION_START
present_vals = set(bmi.unique())
subset_ok = present_vals.issubset(allowed_bmi)
p_norm = (bmi == 'Normal').mean() if 'Normal' in bmi.values else 0.0
p_obese = (bmi == 'Obese').mean() if 'Obese' in bmi.values else 0.0
assert subset_ok and (p_norm >= 0.50) and (p_obese <= 0.10)
# ASSERTION_END

# Heart Rate checks before flagging
hr_num = pd.to_numeric(df['Heart Rate'], errors='raise')

# ASSERTION_START
hr_range_ok = hr_num.notna() & hr_num.between(45, 120)
assert hr_range_ok.all()
# ASSERTION_END

# ASSERTION_START
p_mid_hr = hr_num.between(55, 100).mean()
assert p_mid_hr >= 0.90
# ASSERTION_END

# Sleep Disorder checks before use
sd_col = df['Sleep Disorder']

# ASSERTION_START
valid_sd = sd_col.isna() | sd_col.isin(['Insomnia', 'Sleep Apnea'])
p_null_sd = sd_col.isna().mean()
assert valid_sd.all() and (p_null_sd >= 0.55)
# ASSERTION_END

# Cross-constraints Sleep Disorder <-> QoS
# ASSERTION_START
sd_insomnia_ok = (~sd_col.eq('Insomnia')) | qos_num.le(7)
sd_apnea_ok = (~sd_col.eq('Sleep Apnea')) | qos_num.le(8)
assert sd_insomnia_ok.all() and sd_apnea_ok.all()
# ASSERTION_END

# Derivations and scoring
sleep_bins = [3.0, 5.0, 7.0, 9.0, 12.0]
sleep_labels = ['very_low', 'low', 'optimal', 'high']
sleep_band = pd.cut(sleep_duration, bins=sleep_bins, labels=sleep_labels, include_lowest=True, right=True)

# The following relies on the earlier bounds; invalid values would produce NaN and fail on astype(int)
sleep_penalty_map = {'very_low': -30, 'low': -10, 'optimal': 0, 'high': -10}
sleep_penalty = sleep_band.map(sleep_penalty_map).astype(int)

qos_map = {4: 40, 5: 50, 6: 70, 7: 80, 8: 90, 9: 95}
qos_base = qos_num.map(qos_map).astype(int)

stress_penalty_map = {3: -5, 4: -10, 5: -15, 6: -20, 7: -25, 8: -30}
stress_penalty = stress_num.map(stress_penalty_map).astype(int)

# BP stage classification
cond_crisis = (systolic >= 180) | (diastolic >= 120)
cond_stage2 = (~cond_crisis) & ((systolic >= 140) | (diastolic >= 90))
cond_stage1 = (~cond_crisis) & (~cond_stage2) & (((systolic >= 130) & (systolic <= 139)) | ((diastolic >= 80) & (diastolic <= 89)))
cond_elev = (~cond_crisis) & (~cond_stage2) & (~cond_stage1) & ((systolic >= 120) & (diastolic < 80))

bp_stage = np.select(
    [cond_crisis, cond_stage2, cond_stage1, cond_elev],
    ['Crisis', 'Stage 2', 'Stage 1', 'Elevated'],
    default='Normal'
)

bp_penalty_map = {'Normal': 0, 'Elevated': -5, 'Stage 1': -10, 'Stage 2': -20, 'Crisis': -40}
bp_penalty = pd.Series(bp_stage).map(bp_penalty_map).astype(int)

# Heart rate flags
hr_flag = np.where(hr_num < 55, 'Bradycardia', np.where(hr_num > 100, 'Tachycardia', 'Normal'))
hr_penalty_map = {'Normal': 0, 'Bradycardia': -10, 'Tachycardia': -10}
hr_penalty = pd.Series(hr_flag).map(hr_penalty_map).astype(int)

# BMI penalty
bmi_penalty_map = {'Normal': 0, 'Normal Weight': 0, 'Overweight': -5, 'Obese': -15}
bmi_penalty = bmi.map(bmi_penalty_map).astype(int)

# Sleep disorder penalty (strict indexing relies on earlier checks)
def sd_penalty_func(x):
    if pd.isna(x):
        return 0
    return {'Insomnia': -15, 'Sleep Apnea': -20}[x]

disorder_penalty = sd_col.apply(sd_penalty_func).astype(int)

# Age-based ideal range and cohort typical range
ideal_lower = np.where(age < 65, 7.0, 7.0)
ideal_upper = np.where(age < 65, 9.0, 8.0)

cohort_low = float(sleep_duration.quantile(0.10))
cohort_high = float(sleep_duration.quantile(0.90))

final_low = np.maximum(ideal_lower, cohort_low)
final_high = np.minimum(ideal_upper, cohort_high)

# Composite score
score = qos_base + sleep_penalty + stress_penalty + bp_penalty + hr_penalty + bmi_penalty + disorder_penalty
score = score.clip(lower=0, upper=100)

# Risk level
risk_level = pd.cut(score, bins=[-1, 59, 74, 100], labels=['High', 'Moderate', 'Low'])

# Recommendations and risk flags
def make_flags(i):
    flags = []
    if bp_stage[i] in ['Stage 1', 'Stage 2', 'Crisis']:
        flags.append('Hypertension risk')
    if hr_flag[i] != 'Normal':
        flags.append(hr_flag[i])
    if sleep_band.iloc[i] in ['very_low', 'low']:
        flags.append('Short sleep')
    if sleep_band.iloc[i] == 'high':
        flags.append('Long sleep')
    if stress_num.iloc[i] >= 7:
        flags.append('High stress')
    if (sd_col.iloc[i] == 'Insomnia') or (sd_col.iloc[i] == 'Sleep Apnea'):
        flags.append(str(sd_col.iloc[i]))
    if bmi.iloc[i] == 'Obese':
        flags.append('Obesity')
    if (pal_num.iloc[i] <= 30) and (steps_num.iloc[i] <= 6000):
        flags.append('Low activity')
    return ';'.join(flags) if flags else 'None'

# Personalized recommendation text
def make_reco(i):
    sdur = float(sleep_duration.iloc[i])
    low = float(final_low[i])
    high = float(final_high[i])
    delta = 0.0
    if sdur < low:
        delta = 0.5
    elif sdur > high:
        delta = -0.5
    new_target = min(max(sdur + delta, low), high)
    parts = []
    parts.append(f"Aim for {low:.1f}-{high:.1f}h; next week target {new_target:.1f}h.")
    if stress_num.iloc[i] >= 7:
        parts.append('Prioritize stress management (breathing, breaks).')
    if pal_num.iloc[i] < 60:
        parts.append('Add 15-20 min light activity most days.')
    if steps_num.iloc[i] < 9000:
        parts.append('Increase steps towards 9k+/day.')
    if bp_stage[i] in ['Stage 1', 'Stage 2', 'Crisis']:
        parts.append('Check blood pressure follow-up with clinician.')
    if sd_col.iloc[i] == 'Insomnia':
        parts.append('Consider CBT-I techniques and consistent bedtime.')
    if sd_col.iloc[i] == 'Sleep Apnea':
        parts.append('Adherence to APAP/CPAP and weight management if applicable.')
    return ' '.join(parts)

flags_col = [make_flags(i) for i in range(len(df))]
reco_col = [make_reco(i) for i in range(len(df))]

# Assemble output
out = pd.DataFrame({
    'Person ID': df['Person ID'],
    'Age': age,
    'Gender': df['Gender'].astype(str),
    'Sleep Duration': sleep_duration.round(2),
    'Quality of Sleep': qos_num.astype(int),
    'Stress Level': stress_num.astype(int),
    'Daily Steps': steps_num.astype(int),
    'Physical Activity Level': pal_num.astype(int),
    'Heart Rate': hr_num.astype(int),
    'Systolic': systolic,
    'Diastolic': diastolic,
    'BP Stage': bp_stage,
    'BMI Category': bmi,
    'Sleep Disorder': sd_col.astype('string'),
    'Sleep Band': sleep_band.astype(str),
    'Score': score.astype(int),
    'Risk Level': risk_level.astype(str),
    'Risk Flags': flags_col,
    'Recommendation': reco_col
})

out_fp = os.path.join(output_dir, 'sleep_health_recommendations.csv')
out.to_csv(out_fp, index=False)

print(f'Wrote {len(out)} recommendations to {out_fp}')

import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import re

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('--input', type=str, required=True)
parser.add_argument('--output', type=str, required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()

input_fp = os.path.join(args.input, 'previous_data.csv')
output_dir = args.output
os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)

df = pd.read_csv(input_fp)

bp_series = df['Blood Pressure'].astype(str)

# ASSERTION_START
pattern_ok = bp_series.str.match(r'^\d{2,3}/\d{2,3}$').fillna(False)
assert pattern_ok.all()
# ASSERTION_END

bp_parts = bp_series.str.extract(r'(?P<systolic>\d{2,3})/(?P<diastolic>\d{2,3})')

systolic = bp_parts['systolic'].astype(int)
diastolic = bp_parts['diastolic'].astype(int)

# ASSERTION_START
rng_ok = systolic.between(90, 200) & diastolic.between(50, 130) & (systolic > diastolic)
assert rng_ok.all()
# ASSERTION_END

# Age checks before age-based logic
age_num = pd.to_numeric(df['Age'], errors='raise')

# ASSERTION_START
age_ok = age_num.notna() & age_num.between(18, 80) & ((age_num % 1) == 0)
assert age_ok.all()
# ASSERTION_END

age = age_num.astype(int)

# Sleep Duration checks before banding and scoring
sleep_duration = pd.to_numeric(df['Sleep Duration'], errors='raise')

# ASSERTION_START
sd_ok = sleep_duration.notna() & sleep_duration.between(3.0, 12.0)
assert sd_ok.all()
# ASSERTION_END

# ASSERTION_START
in_core = sleep_duration.between(5.0, 9.0)
prop_core = in_core.mean()
assert prop_core >= 0.80
# ASSERTION_END

# Quality of Sleep checks before mapping
qos_num = pd.to_numeric(df['Quality of Sleep'], errors='raise')

# ASSERTION_START
qos_bounds = qos_num.notna() & qos_num.between(1, 10) & ((qos_num % 1) == 0)
assert qos_bounds.all()
# ASSERTION_END

# ASSERTION_START
qos_window_ok = qos_num.between(4, 9)
assert qos_window_ok.all()
# ASSERTION_END

# ASSERTION_START
prop_high_q = qos_num.isin([6, 7, 8, 9]).mean()
assert prop_high_q >= 0.90
# ASSERTION_END

# Stress Level checks before mapping
stress_num = pd.to_numeric(df['Stress Level'], errors='raise')

# ASSERTION_START
stress_ok = stress_num.notna() & stress_num.between(1, 10) & ((stress_num % 1) == 0)
assert stress_ok.all()
# ASSERTION_END

# ASSERTION_START
stress_obs_ok = stress_num.between(3, 8)
assert stress_obs_ok.all()
# ASSERTION_END

# Cross-constraints Sleep Duration <-> Quality of Sleep
# ASSERTION_START
c1 = (~sleep_duration.lt(5.0)) | qos_num.le(6)
c2 = (~sleep_duration.ge(8.0)) | qos_num.ge(7)
assert c1.all() and c2.all()
# ASSERTION_END

# Physical Activity Level checks before banding
pal_num = pd.to_numeric(df['Physical Activity Level'], errors='raise')

# ASSERTION_START
pal_ok = pal_num.notna() & pal_num.between(0, 180) & ((pal_num % 1) == 0)
assert pal_ok.all()
# ASSERTION_END

# Daily Steps checks before banding
steps_num = pd.to_numeric(df['Daily Steps'], errors='raise')

# ASSERTION_START
steps_ok = steps_num.notna() & steps_num.between(0, 40000) & ((steps_num % 1) == 0)
assert steps_ok.all()
# ASSERTION_END

# Cross-constraints PAL <-> Steps used for engagement rules
# ASSERTION_START
c_pal_hi = (~pal_num.ge(90)) | steps_num.ge(9000)
c_pal_lo = (~pal_num.le(30)) | steps_num.le(6000)
assert c_pal_hi.all() and c_pal_lo.all()
# ASSERTION_END

# BMI Category checks before mapping
bmi = df['BMI Category'].astype(str)
allowed_bmi = {'Normal', 'Normal Weight', 'Overweight', 'Obese'}

# ASSERTION_START
present_vals = set(bmi.unique())
subset_ok = present_vals.issubset(allowed_bmi)
p_norm = (bmi == 'Normal').mean() if 'Normal' in bmi.values else 0.0
p_obese = (bmi == 'Obese').mean() if 'Obese' in bmi.values else 0.0
assert subset_ok and (p_norm >= 0.50) and (p_obese <= 0.10)
# ASSERTION_END

# Heart Rate checks before flagging
hr_num = pd.to_numeric(df['Heart Rate'], errors='raise')

# ASSERTION_START
hr_range_ok = hr_num.notna() & hr_num.between(45, 120)
assert hr_range_ok.all()
# ASSERTION_END

# ASSERTION_START
p_mid_hr = hr_num.between(55, 100).mean()
assert p_mid_hr >= 0.90
# ASSERTION_END

# Sleep Disorder checks before use
sd_col = df['Sleep Disorder']

# ASSERTION_START
valid_sd = sd_col.isna() | sd_col.isin(['Insomnia', 'Sleep Apnea'])
p_null_sd = sd_col.isna().mean()
assert valid_sd.all() and (p_null_sd >= 0.55)
# ASSERTION_END

# Cross-constraints Sleep Disorder <-> QoS
# ASSERTION_START
sd_insomnia_ok = (~sd_col.eq('Insomnia')) | qos_num.le(7)
sd_apnea_ok = (~sd_col.eq('Sleep Apnea')) | qos_num.le(8)
assert sd_insomnia_ok.all() and sd_apnea_ok.all()
# ASSERTION_END

# Derivations and scoring
sleep_bins = [3.0, 5.0, 7.0, 9.0, 12.0]
sleep_labels = ['very_low', 'low', 'optimal', 'high']
sleep_band = pd.cut(sleep_duration, bins=sleep_bins, labels=sleep_labels, include_lowest=True, right=True)

# The following relies on the earlier bounds; invalid values would produce NaN and fail on astype(int)
sleep_penalty_map = {'very_low': -30, 'low': -10, 'optimal': 0, 'high': -10}
sleep_penalty = sleep_band.map(sleep_penalty_map).astype(int)

qos_map = {4: 40, 5: 50, 6: 70, 7: 80, 8: 90, 9: 95}
qos_base = qos_num.map(qos_map).astype(int)

stress_penalty_map = {3: -5, 4: -10, 5: -15, 6: -20, 7: -25, 8: -30}
stress_penalty = stress_num.map(stress_penalty_map).astype(int)

# BP stage classification
cond_crisis = (systolic >= 180) | (diastolic >= 120)
cond_stage2 = (~cond_crisis) & ((systolic >= 140) | (diastolic >= 90))
cond_stage1 = (~cond_crisis) & (~cond_stage2) & (((systolic >= 130) & (systolic <= 139)) | ((diastolic >= 80) & (diastolic <= 89)))
cond_elev = (~cond_crisis) & (~cond_stage2) & (~cond_stage1) & ((systolic >= 120) & (diastolic < 80))

bp_stage = np.select(
    [cond_crisis, cond_stage2, cond_stage1, cond_elev],
    ['Crisis', 'Stage 2', 'Stage 1', 'Elevated'],
    default='Normal'
)

bp_penalty_map = {'Normal': 0, 'Elevated': -5, 'Stage 1': -10, 'Stage 2': -20, 'Crisis': -40}
bp_penalty = pd.Series(bp_stage).map(bp_penalty_map).astype(int)

# Heart rate flags
hr_flag = np.where(hr_num < 55, 'Bradycardia', np.where(hr_num > 100, 'Tachycardia', 'Normal'))
hr_penalty_map = {'Normal': 0, 'Bradycardia': -10, 'Tachycardia': -10}
hr_penalty = pd.Series(hr_flag).map(hr_penalty_map).astype(int)

# BMI penalty
bmi_penalty_map = {'Normal': 0, 'Normal Weight': 0, 'Overweight': -5, 'Obese': -15}
bmi_penalty = bmi.map(bmi_penalty_map).astype(int)

# Sleep disorder penalty (strict indexing relies on earlier checks)
def sd_penalty_func(x):
    if pd.isna(x):
        return 0
    return {'Insomnia': -15, 'Sleep Apnea': -20}[x]

disorder_penalty = sd_col.apply(sd_penalty_func).astype(int)

# Age-based ideal range and cohort typical range
ideal_lower = np.where(age < 65, 7.0, 7.0)
ideal_upper = np.where(age < 65, 9.0, 8.0)

cohort_low = float(sleep_duration.quantile(0.10))
cohort_high = float(sleep_duration.quantile(0.90))

final_low = np.maximum(ideal_lower, cohort_low)
final_high = np.minimum(ideal_upper, cohort_high)

# Composite score
score = qos_base + sleep_penalty + stress_penalty + bp_penalty + hr_penalty + bmi_penalty + disorder_penalty
score = score.clip(lower=0, upper=100)

# Risk level
risk_level = pd.cut(score, bins=[-1, 59, 74, 100], labels=['High', 'Moderate', 'Low'])

# Recommendations and risk flags
def make_flags(i):
    flags = []
    if bp_stage[i] in ['Stage 1', 'Stage 2', 'Crisis']:
        flags.append('Hypertension risk')
    if hr_flag[i] != 'Normal':
        flags.append(hr_flag[i])
    if sleep_band.iloc[i] in ['very_low', 'low']:
        flags.append('Short sleep')
    if sleep_band.iloc[i] == 'high':
        flags.append('Long sleep')
    if stress_num.iloc[i] >= 7:
        flags.append('High stress')
    if (sd_col.iloc[i] == 'Insomnia') or (sd_col.iloc[i] == 'Sleep Apnea'):
        flags.append(str(sd_col.iloc[i]))
    if bmi.iloc[i] == 'Obese':
        flags.append('Obesity')
    if (pal_num.iloc[i] <= 30) and (steps_num.iloc[i] <= 6000):
        flags.append('Low activity')
    return ';'.join(flags) if flags else 'None'

# Personalized recommendation text
def make_reco(i):
    sdur = float(sleep_duration.iloc[i])
    low = float(final_low[i])
    high = float(final_high[i])
    delta = 0.0
    if sdur < low:
        delta = 0.5
    elif sdur > high:
        delta = -0.5
    new_target = min(max(sdur + delta, low), high)
    parts = []
    parts.append(f"Aim for {low:.1f}-{high:.1f}h; next week target {new_target:.1f}h.")
    if stress_num.iloc[i] >= 7:
        parts.append('Prioritize stress management (breathing, breaks).')
    if pal_num.iloc[i] < 60:
        parts.append('Add 15-20 min light activity most days.')
    if steps_num.iloc[i] < 9000:
        parts.append('Increase steps towards 9k+/day.')
    if bp_stage[i] in ['Stage 1', 'Stage 2', 'Crisis']:
        parts.append('Check blood pressure follow-up with clinician.')
    if sd_col.iloc[i] == 'Insomnia':
        parts.append('Consider CBT-I techniques and consistent bedtime.')
    if sd_col.iloc[i] == 'Sleep Apnea':
        parts.append('Adherence to APAP/CPAP and weight management if applicable.')
    return ' '.join(parts)

flags_col = [make_flags(i) for i in range(len(df))]
reco_col = [make_reco(i) for i in range(len(df))]

# Assemble output
out = pd.DataFrame({
    'Person ID': df['Person ID'],
    'Age': age,
    'Gender': df['Gender'].astype(str),
    'Sleep Duration': sleep_duration.round(2),
    'Quality of Sleep': qos_num.astype(int),
    'Stress Level': stress_num.astype(int),
    'Daily Steps': steps_num.astype(int),
    'Physical Activity Level': pal_num.astype(int),
    'Heart Rate': hr_num.astype(int),
    'Systolic': systolic,
    'Diastolic': diastolic,
    'BP Stage': bp_stage,
    'BMI Category': bmi,
    'Sleep Disorder': sd_col.astype('string'),
    'Sleep Band': sleep_band.astype(str),
    'Score': score.astype(int),
    'Risk Level': risk_level.astype(str),
    'Risk Flags': flags_col,
    'Recommendation': reco_col
})

out_fp = os.path.join(output_dir, 'sleep_health_recommendations.csv')
out.to_csv(out_fp, index=False)

print(f'Wrote {len(out)} recommendations to {out_fp}')
